one_line: Strongly load-bearing: full 5/5 vs ablated 0/5; without it every PR targets the predecessor branch.
reasoning: FULL outputs (R01,R02,R03,R04,R07) all use --base main: 5/5. ABLATED outputs (R00,R05,R06,R08,R09) all use --base A targeting the predecessor branch: 0/5.
